# Tool.Cars

> Tool.Cars (https://tool.goldenpasss.com/) is an independent review and comparison site for car tech you can buy and install yourself, organised in one tab per product type: scan tools (iCARZONE, Innova, ROVE borescope), CarPlay (Youducar head units, Carlinkit wireless adapters and AI boxes), dash cams (ROVE, Fanttik) and tire inflators, jump starters and car vacuums (Fanttik). Each tab starts with a brand-vs-brand table, then a two-product comparison and every product with prices in USD, linking to the brand's official store or Amazon listing. The site earns affiliate commissions on purchases.

Last updated: 2026-10-24. Prices are set by each brand and may change; always confirm on the product page.

## Pages

- [Tool.Cars home](https://tool.goldenpasss.com/): match a car symptom (check engine light, misfires, dead battery, no CarPlay) to the right tool, plus a general FAQ.
- [Scan tools](https://tool.goldenpasss.com/icarzone/): iCARZONE vs Innova brand table and head-to-head (code readers, codes + battery, ABS/SRS, bidirectional, all-system tablets), 14 Innova tools and Innova/ROVE borescopes, plus every iCARZONE scanner by category (JU flagship, UR bidirectional, MA DIY testers, HD heavy-duty, OBD-I adapters), a full comparison table, head-to-head comparisons, buying notes and an FAQ on ABS/SRS scanners, EPB reset, bidirectional tools and tools under $100.
- [Dash cams](https://tool.goldenpasss.com/dash-cams/): ROVE vs Fanttik; ROVE R2-4K (front, 4K), R2-4K Dual (front + rear, 128GB card included), R3 (3-channel), Fanttik Luma K10 Apex 4K, plus ROVE microSD cards, mounts, CPL filters and hardwire kit.
- [Tire inflators](https://tool.goldenpasss.com/tire-inflators/): Fanttik cordless tire inflators (X8, X9, X10, X11), jump starters (T8, T10, Beyond 10), bundles, car vacuums, cordless pressure washers and accessories.
- [CarPlay](https://tool.goldenpasss.com/carplay-screen/): Youducar head units vs Carlinkit wireless adapters and AI boxes (sold on carlinkitcarplay.com and autokitcarplay.com), then Youducar Android head units by vehicle (Toyota, Ford, Chevy/GMC, Jeep, Honda, Ram and more), with wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, compared side by side; fitment FAQ.
- [About Tool.Cars](https://tool.goldenpasss.com/about/): who runs the site, how products are compared, where prices, specs and reviews come from, and how affiliate commissions work.

## Quick facts

- Cheapest iCARZONE code reader: MA100, about $23 (reads/clears engine codes, I/M readiness, all 1996+ US OBD2 cars).
- Scanner + battery tester in one: MA900, about $70 (12V/24V battery, cranking and charging tests).
- Cheapest iCARZONE bidirectional tool: MA200 V6, about $100 (6 service resets: oil, EPB, steering angle, DPF, BMS, TPMS).
- ABS + SRS (airbag) + transmission on a budget: MA200 Plus (about $145) or UR600 (about $200).
- Best-value full-system bidirectional tool with ECU coding: UR800, about $240. Flagship handheld: UR1000, about $330 (7" screen, TPMS). Workshop level: JU2000 / JU2000 MAX.
- iCARZONE lists lifetime free software updates, no annual subscription, 1-year hardware warranty.
- Youducar head units: vehicle-specific, plug-and-play factory-style connectors, wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, factory camera and steering wheel button support; screens from about $210. Code YDTHANH10 gives 10% off orders over $300 on youducar.com.
- Innova (scan tools): 5110 check engine code reader about $66; 5210 code reader + battery tester about $90; Innova 1000 Bluetooth OBD2 scanner for iPhone and Android about $100; 5310 ABS + SRS about $140; SD35 ABS/SRS/TPMS about $150; 5410 all-system about $180; 5510 ABS bleed + caliper service about $225; 5610 bidirectional about $350. 3170RS and 5512 also read OBD1 cars. Innova 3380 borescope about $100.
- iCARZONE vs Innova in one line: iCARZONE suits DIYers to small shops who want bidirectional tests and ECU coding, with lifetime free updates; Innova suits DIYers who want step-by-step fixes in the RepairSolutions2 phone app (sold on Amazon).
- ROVE dash cams: R2-4K (front, 4K, WiFi, GPS) about $120; R2-4K Dual (front + rear, STARVIS 2 sensor, 128GB card included) about $150; R3 (front, rear and cabin, 3-channel, 3" touch screen) about $300. ROVE hardwire kit about $30 for parking mode.
- Fanttik dash cam: Luma K10 Apex 4K about $320.
- Fanttik tire inflators: X9 Classic about $46 (cheapest); X10 Pro about $72; X8 APEX and X9 APEX about $90; X11 Pro+ about $90; X10 APEX about $110; X10 Cross about $120; X10 Pro Max about $130; X9 Ultra for pickup trucks about $170.
- Fanttik jump starters: Potent T10 1800A about $100; Beyond 10 Apex (jump starter + air compressor in one) about $170; inflator + jump starter bundles (X8/X9 + T10) from about $166.
- Fanttik car vacuums: V8 Mate about $80, Slim V10 Lite about $90, Slim V10 APEX about $110, Cruise V11 APEX about $120.
- Carlinkit wireless CarPlay adapters (car must already have wired CarPlay): Mini SE about $45 (CarPlay only); Mini3 about $48 and Mini Ultra about $55 (CarPlay + Android Auto); Carlinkit 5.0 (2air) about $66; A2A wireless Android Auto adapter about $64; T2C for Tesla about $70.
- Carlinkit AI boxes (Android system that runs YouTube/Netflix on the car screen, plus wireless CarPlay): T-Box Basic about $70, Tbox Lite about $72, Tbox Plus about $169, Tbox Max about $175, Tbox UHD about $228, Tbox Ultra about $329, Tbox Ultra 3 (Android 15) about $359. Same products are sold as AutoKit on autokitcarplay.com.
- Which CarPlay route: car has wired CarPlay -> Carlinkit adapter ($45-$66). Car has no CarPlay screen at all -> Youducar vehicle-specific head unit (screens from about $210).
